LocationDescriptions.5:
A heavy door, banded in iron, set into the living rock. It is the only thing down here that was made rather than found, and it does not belong to the cave: whatever is on the other side of it is not more cave.

Walked out of here:
Gavin, who got out.
Haley, who got out.
Edward, who got out.
LocationDescriptions.8:
Twenty steps cut square out of the rock, going down, and the last six of them are under water. The water is black and flat and colder than the air above it; at the bottom it comes to your knees and no further, and it does not move at all, even when you do.

The stair ends at a fall of stone. It is not a collapse. The blocks are cut square and they were stacked into the opening on purpose, from this side, by somebody who meant it to stay shut — and then time leaned on them and left gaps a hand will go into and nothing else.

Beside the wall, cut small and neat into the rock at shoulder height: TOGETHER. Under the word, two tally marks. Under the tallies, nothing.

Stones taken out of this wall, and by whom:
the first, by Edward.
the second, by Ravick.
